source.title: The effect of forward postural lean on running economy, kinematics, and muscle activation
source.authors: Nina M. Carson, Daniel H. Aslan, Justus D. Ortega
source.protocol: Level treadmill running at 3.58 m/s; five-minute trials; 20 strides analyzed with a 200 Hz Vicon system.

chunks.text: The study defined postural lean as the absolute angle of the segment from the stance ankle joint to C7 relative to vertical. Torso flexion was the sacral-marker-to-C7 segment relative to vertical, averaged across the gait cycle.
chunks.caveat: The service uses Halpe26 neck and hip-center points as 2-D proxies for C7 and the sacral marker; the values are not measurement-equivalent to Vicon.

chunks.text: Table 1 reports mean postural lean angles of 1.7 degrees for upright, 4.3 degrees for both moderate strategies, and about 8.2 to 8.4 degrees for large-lean strategies. Mean torso-flexion angles were 4.9, 12.1, 16.3, 17.4, and 21.8 degrees across the five conditions.
chunks.caveat: These are experimental-condition means from this sample, not universal normal or abnormal thresholds.

chunks.text: Table 1 reports peak hip flexion means from 28.6 degrees in the upright condition to 35.4 to 37.6 degrees in the large-lean conditions. Peak knee flexion means ranged from 40.6 to 42.2 degrees across conditions.
chunks.caveat: The table values came from a 3-D Vicon joint model. Halpe26 2-D proxy angles must be described as approximate and should not be directly graded against these means.

chunks.text: In this controlled protocol, greater forward lean increased net metabolic cost and was associated with larger peak hip and knee flexion during stance. The hip-flexion change was larger than the knee-flexion change.
chunks.caveat: A video-only system cannot measure metabolic cost, so it may report the study association but must not claim the user's running economy changed.

chunks.text: The authors caution that the trained-runner sample and fixed treadmill speed may limit generalization. Different runners may also achieve the same lean angle through different multi-segment strategies.
chunks.caveat: The service should present the paper as contextual evidence rather than a population-wide diagnostic standard.
